sovereign_country.strategic_role: 连接拉美市场的欧洲商贸桥梁、本地化仓配与数字游民签证

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain-Argentina BIT, Spain-Brazil BIT, Spain-Mexico BIT, Spain-Chile BIT, and over 80 active BITs and DTAs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Ley 7/2021) and Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, approving the UBO register regulation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Clearance and Incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, and UBOs per Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 304/2014

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Mandatory use of Spanish language and Latin script; no transliteration permitted
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Reserved public-administration terms, offensive or misleading words, trademark-infringing designations, or names that could confuse investors
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Administrative appeal before the competent Commercial Registry or appeal to the relevant court within the statutory period

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for SL entities; substance requirements apply for REIT qualification under Law 11/2009
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for standard SL formation; medium for REIT activities due to regulatory oversight

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and clearance through Registro Mercantil
UBO identification, verification, and PEP/sanctions screening
Legal opinion, incorporation filing, and compliance report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff or prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC), Articles 19–22 (formation and public deed), 58–62 (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada capital shares), 72–74 (minimum capital and payment), 113–126 (registered office), 196–223 (directors and administration). Optional REIT election under Ley 11/2009, de 26 de octubre, reguladora de las SOCIMI, if later converted to a listed Sociedad Anónima.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Commercial Registry of the registered office), coordinated through the Registro Central de Denominaciones for name clearance, under the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (notarized public deed of incorporation) filed and registered with the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada requires a minimum share capital of EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid in cash or in kind. Cash capital must be evidenced by a certificate of payment issued by a Spanish credit institution holding the funds in a company-designated escrow or capital deposit account; the funds are generally blocked until registration and may be released only after the commercial registry inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: After careful review of the draft articles of association and the feasibility plan, the founders unanimously resolve: (i) to subscribe in full the share capital of EUR 3,000, represented in equal registered participations, each fully paid via bank certificate; (ii) to approve the bylaws and adopt as registered office the premises at [address] in Madrid, Spain; (iii) to appoint [Director A] as sole administrator and [Director B] as secretary, each accepting office and filing Form 036 for provisional tax identification; (iv) to deposit the capital and execute the public deed before a notary; (v) to authorize the legal representative to file the deed with the Registro Mercantil and complete all registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Central de Denominaciones and Oficina de Extranjería (National Police for NIE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic application for a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) identifying at least three available company names; concurrently, non-resident founders must obtain a Spanish NIE number by submitting Form EX-15 at the relevant foreigners office or Spanish consulate. The approved name certificate is valid for three months and must be presented to the notary.
required_dossiers: Identification and passport of each founder
Proposed company name list and activity description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for collision with existing entities, resubmit the request with a different name order; if NIE processing is delayed, request an urgent appointment and provisional NIE number at the police station.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Escrow Account Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution (bank) authorized by Banco de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate designation account in the future SL name and deposit the minimum capital of EUR 3,000. Instruct the bank to issue a certificate of payment (certificado de desembolso) stating the amount, account holder, date, and blocked status. If non-cash contributions are used, obtain an independent expert valuation report as required by LSC Article 74.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank challenges identification or source of funds, provide updated corporate and tax documentation, amend the account signatory list, and obtain a corrected certificate before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Public Deed Before Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public within the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the chosen notary with the approved name certificate, bank deposit certificate, bylaws, and founder identification. Sign the public deed of incorporation (escritura pública), which must include the company name, registered office address, corporate purpose, capital structure, directors, and representation powers. The notary will formalize the deed and deliver an open copy for presentation to the mercantile registry.
required_dossiers: NIE and passport of each founder
Entry in the Central Registry of Beneficial Ownership if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies inconsistencies between the bylaws and mandatory law, execute a resolutory or corrective addendum before the same notary; if any founder is absent, schedule a new appointment or use a notarized power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional Tax Identification and Commercial Registry Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Registro Mercantil Provincial
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after deed execution, file Form 036 with the AEAT to obtain a provisional NIF; then present a certified copy of the public deed to the Provincial Commercial Registry within two months. Pay the applicable notarial and registry tariffs, and return with the registry inscription certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate from the notary of payment of relevant taxes
Directors' acceptance of office and address declaration
Application for registration signed by directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry files defects (nota defectación), they must be cured by presenting an additional notarial resolution or supplementary documentation within the legal period; if the two-month deadline is missed, obtain a judicial approval of late filing or re-notarize the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax and Social Security Legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT Central Office, Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social, and the Provincial Statistical Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After commercial registration is granted, obtain the definitive NIF by submitting Form 030 (change of address and definitive CIF). Register the company as an employer with the Social Security treasury, file the company census declaration, and inscribe the deed and appropriation of capital in the Mercantile Registry for statistical purposes.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT rejects the definitive NIF or requests additional information, provide the registry certificate and statutory declarations directly to the provincial tax office; for social security, use the RED system to resolve any registration mismatch.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Consejería de Industria of the Autonomous Community and municipal licensing division through the Ventanilla Única de Actividades Económicas (single economic activity window)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de apertura y funcionamiento / comunicación previa de actividad económica (establishment opening and operating permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Dirección General de Calidad y Evaluación Ambiental del Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico, together with the regional environmental authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B simplified environmental assessment (evaluación ambiental simplificada) for office and commercial real estate activities; a full environmental impact assessment under Annex I of Law 21/2013 is required only for large urban development or infrastructure projects; typical investment-property leasing is registered through the municipal activity license system.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Royal Decree 1/2016 for non-domestic wastewater discharge to municipal sewers; Royal Decree 115/2017 for VOC emission limits; Law 7/2022 for waste classification, storage, and hazardous waste manifest obligations; any cooling and refrigeration systems must comply with F-gas regulation and fluorinated greenhouse gas quotas.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification in accordance with the Código Técnico de la Edificación (CTE DB-SI) and Royal Decree 513/2017, including table of stored materials and emergency lighting; structural load inspection certificate and mandatory periodic inspections of buildings in Madrid; workplace health and safety risk evaluation and corresponding occupational health service appointment under Law 31/1995.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Spanish Tax Agency, official portal https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish SL entities obtain NIF automatically upon notarial incorporation and Mercantile Registry registration with AEAT. Foreign-owned entities or non-residents establishing operations in Spain must register with AEAT, appoint a tax representative (apoderado), submit corporate documents, and complete registry formalities to secure statutory TIN equivalent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Qualifying REITs may enter the SOCIMI special regime, which preserves entity-level taxation with mandatory compliance obligations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing via AEAT SII system for most transactions with real-time reporting. Digital stamping and fiscal clearance integrated with customs for cross-border supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods exported outside the EU (shipment or transport) and qualifying offshore services. Eligibility requires documentary proof that the supply is an export and that the place of supply falls outside EU territory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in fines up to 100% of evaded VAT, possible criminal prosecution for tax fraud, and retrospective clawback with interest and surcharges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) and the Spanish Ministry of Economic Affairs and Digital Transformation (Secretaría de Estado de Economía y Apoyo a la Empresa) jointly administer foreign exchange regulations, with the Banco de España acting as the primary supervisory and licensing authority for banking and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain, as a member of the European Union and the Eurozone, maintains full capital and current account convertibility under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) and the EU Capital Movements Directive (88/361/EEC). There are no general restrictions on the conversion of EUR to foreign currencies or on the repatriation of profits, dividends, or capital for non-resident investors. However, certain reporting obligations apply to transactions exceeding €10,000 (cash) or €100,000 (financial transfers) for statistical and anti-money laundering purposes. Profit remittance is subject to standard corporate tax withholding (19% for non-resident shareholders, unless reduced by tax treaties) and requires compliance with transfer pricing documentation if applicable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain does not impose any mandatory surrender or conversion requirements for export proceeds. Exporters are free to hold foreign currency in domestic or foreign bank accounts, and there is no statutory timeline for repatriation. However, all cross-border transactions exceeding €10,000 must be reported to the Banco de España for statistical and AML/CFT purposes via the 'Declaración de Movimientos de Medios de Pago' (DMP) form. For a REIT (SOCIMI) engaged in real estate investment, export proceeds are not a typical revenue stream; the primary inflows are rental income and capital gains, which are not subject to any surrender rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (for rental income, distributions, and operational expenses)
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account (for initial capital injection and reserve funds)
Operational Account (for property management and dividend distributions)
Operational Account (for treasury management and FX hedging)
Operational Account (for high-net-worth and institutional clients)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and payment institutions licensed in Spain (e.g., Bnext, N26, Revolut) are viable for basic operational banking, but they are generally not suitable for a REIT's complex treasury needs. They lack the capacity for large-scale cross-border wire transfers, multi-currency accounts, and dedicated relationship management. Additionally, many EMIs impose transaction limits and may not support escrow or capital injection structures. For a REIT, a traditional tier-1 bank is strongly recommended. The viability rating is 'Low' for primary banking, but 'Medium' for ancillary payment processing (e.g., rental collections via ACH).
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Spanish SL (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada) with non-resident directors, most tier-1 banks require at least one director or the legal representative to appear physically at the branch for the initial KYC interview and signature verification. Remote opening is possible for certain banks (e.g., BBVA, Santander) if the entity has a Spanish tax ID (NIF) and the directors undergo video identification, but this is subject to enhanced due diligence. For a REIT with a complex ownership structure, physical presence is strongly recommended to expedite onboarding and avoid compliance delays. The mandate is 'Physical presence required for at least one director or authorized signatory, unless the bank approves a remote video KYC process with notarized documents.'

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex ownership structure with multiple layers of non-resident shareholders or trusts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a full corporate ownership chart (up to ultimate beneficial owners), certified copies of incorporation documents, shareholder registry, and a legal opinion from a Spanish attorney confirming the REIT's compliance with SOCIMI regulations (Law 11/2009). Include audited financial statements and tax filings to demonstrate legitimate business purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border transactions, particularly dividend distributions to non-EU shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a detailed distribution policy, board resolutions approving each dividend, and evidence of underlying real estate assets (property deeds, rental contracts). Provide tax residency certificates of shareholders and applicable double taxation treaty provisions to justify withholding rates. Maintain a transaction log with purpose codes (e.g., 'Dividend Distribution' under EU Regulation 2018/1672).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection from a jurisdiction with higher AML risk (e.g., offshore financial centers)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a source-of-funds declaration with bank statements from the sending institution, a notarized gift or loan agreement, and a certified copy of the capital contribution resolution. Obtain a legal opinion from the sending jurisdiction's counsel confirming the legitimacy of the funds. If the transfer exceeds €100,000, file the DMP declaration with the Banco de España.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained discrepancies between declared business activity (real estate investment) and actual transaction patterns (e.g., frequent FX trades)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a treasury policy document outlining FX hedging strategies (forwards, swaps) and provide board minutes approving each hedging transaction. Include a risk management framework that aligns with the REIT's investment mandate. Provide monthly reconciliation reports and audited financial statements to substantiate the business rationale.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For inbound capital injections (e.g., equity contributions from non-resident shareholders), the compliant routing is via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank transfers) using the beneficiary's IBAN (International Bank Account Number) and BIC/SWIFT code. The payment must include a clear purpose code under the EU Regulation (EC) No 924/2009 and the Spanish 'Declaración de Movimientos de Medios de Pago' (DMP) if the amount exceeds €10,000. Recommended purpose codes: 'S010' (Equity capital) or 'S020' (Loans) for capital injections. The bank will require a copy of the board resolution approving the capital increase, the notarized deed of incorporation, and the NIF (Tax ID) certificate. For a REIT, the injection should be recorded as paid-in capital or share premium, and the bank may require a legal opinion confirming the SOCIMI status to ensure no adverse tax implications.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound trade disbursements, primarily dividend distributions to shareholders and operational payments (e.g., property maintenance, taxes), the clearing rails are: (1) SWIFT MT103 for cross-border wire transfers to non-EU beneficiaries, with proper purpose codes (e.g., 'D010' for dividends) and supporting documentation (board resolution, tax withholding certificate). (2) SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) for EU/EEA payments, which is faster and lower-cost, using the IBAN and BIC. For large distributions, banks may require pre-notification and a copy of the distribution agreement. For trade settlements related to property acquisitions, a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) may be used, but for a REIT, direct wire transfers are more common. All outbound transfers exceeding €10,000 must be reported via the DMP form to the Banco de España.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (deliverable) - OTC contracts with a bank to lock in exchange rates for future dividend distributions or property acquisitions in foreign currencies.
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) - Used for currencies with limited convertibility, though not typical for EUR-based REITs; may be used for exposure to emerging market currencies.
Cross-Currency Swaps - To manage long-term currency risk on foreign-denominated debt or investments, allowing exchange of principal and interest payments.
FX Options - Over-the-counter or exchange-traded options to hedge downside risk while retaining upside potential, subject to board approval and risk management policies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts (Cuentas Anuales) and mandatory shareholders’ listing with the Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry / Registro Mercantil Central, Ministry of Justice (Spain)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual General Meeting must approve the accounts within 6 months of fiscal year end; deposit due within 1 month of approval — for a 31-December year end the effective cut-off is 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry closure ('cierre registral') blocks all subsequent filings; monetary sanction EUR 200–1,200; failure to deposit for 3 consecutive years triggers cancellation of the registry record and administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: AEAT — Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (State Tax Agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months and 25 days after fiscal year end; 25 July following a 31-December year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% of the outstanding liability plus statutory late-payment interest; minimum fixed penalty EUR 150; un-filed returns after 12 months may be assessed with a full penalty up to 20% of tax due

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: AEAT — Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (State Tax Agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January following the calendar year for standard quarterly filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal offence penalties from EUR 150 up to EUR 1,500 based on length of delay and stated tax volume; late-payment interest applied on any VAT declared due in the period

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual withholding recapitulative returns: Modelo 190 (labor income) and Modelo 193 / Modelo 180 (real-estate rental and capital income paid to third parties and non-residents)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: AEAT — Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (State Tax Agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Modelo 190 by 31 January following the calendar year; Modelo 193 by 31 January following the calendar year; Modelo 180 by 31 January following the calendar year for rental payments to individuals and non-residents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharges of 5%–20% of unreported withholding plus late-payment interest; minimum penalty EUR 150 per return; non-filing exposing the SL to criminal filing threshold issues where unreported withholdings exceed EUR 50,000

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration of exemption or self-assessment for the Economic Activities Tax (IAE) — Modelo 848 / Modelo 840
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: AEAT (state-managed municipal tax in coordination with the relevant Ayuntamiento)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 15 February following the calendar year for the exemption declaration; Modelo 840 annual payments apply only where taxable turnover exceeds EUR 1,000,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the exemption or self-assessment declaration attracts fiscal penalties of EUR 400–4,000 and loss of the IAE exemption privilege for the ensuing year

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization and stamping of mandatory corporate books (legalización y sellado: Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales, Libro Diario, Libro de Actas, registers of members and directors)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) where the company is domiciled
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of each fiscal year (30 April for a 31-December year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 6,000; the books lose legal evidentiary value and the SL may not validly rely upon them in shareholder, tax or insolvency proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual filing confirming ultimate beneficial owners (actualización/confirmación de la titularidad real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro de Titularidades Reales — Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública, Ministry of Justice (channeled via the Mercantile Registry online portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: UBO data must be confirmed or updated within 1 month of any qualifying change in shareholding (threshold 25%); the annual confirmation is commercially coupled to the 31 July annual accounts deposit deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Blockage of every subsequent Mercantile Registry filing until the UBO record is cured; AML fines for inaccurate, late or missing beneficial-ownership data range from EUR 600 to EUR 60,000 under Law 10/2010

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements and annual statutory filings applicable to a licensed real-estate investment trust vehicle (when authorized as a collective real-estate investment institution by CNMV; note the ES_SL corporate form is not eligible for the SOCIMI regime, which is reserved for listed Sociedades Anónimas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: CNMV — Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (when the REIT trust vehicle is CNMV-regulated)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For CNMV-regulated real-estate vehicles: audited annual accounts within 4 months of fiscal year end and annual report within 6 months of fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative sanction up to EUR 300,000 or 2% of own funds for serious regulatory filing breaches; risk of suspension of the trust's marketing license, disqualification of directors and compulsory capital reinforcement

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an SL when, for two consecutive years, at least two of the three quantitative thresholds are met: total assets > EUR 2,850,000; net turnover > EUR 5,700,000; average workforce > 50 employees (LSC art. 263; EU Directive 2013/34). Audit is compulsory irrespective of size for companies forming part of a consolidated group, public-interest entities, and CNMV-regulated real-estate collective investment institutions. The SOCIMI (REIT) tax regime in Spain is reserved for listed Sociedades Anónimas; the ES_SL therefore follows the general standard SL audit thresholds unless separately licensed as a collective real-estate institution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish local GAAP — Plan General de Contabilidad (RD 1514/2007, as amended by RD 1/2021 and RD 2/2021) together with the Spanish Commercial Code; EU-endorsed IFRS applies only where the SL is an issuer of listed securities or belongs to a consolidated group filing IFRS financial statements. A licensed real-estate collective investment institution must additionally observe the specific CNMV accounting circulars.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 10/2010 and RD 304/2014, the SL must file or update the beneficial-ownership declaration (Declaración de Titularidad Real) with the Registro de Titularidades Reales within one month of any change in the ownership structure or identity of ultimate beneficial owners above the 25% participation threshold. There is no separate due date for a passive 'annual confirmation'; the registry enforces the obligation by blocking every Mercantile Registry submission, including the annual accounts deposit and any share-transfer registration, until the UBO information is current, and the periodic shareholders' listing filed with the accounts provides the cross-checking data. Each transfer of participations must first be recorded in the Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios) and evidenced by notarial deed where required, then reflected in the UBO declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios – LSC art. 343)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)
Inventory and Annual Accounts Book (Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800–2,500 per annum for a Madrid/Barcelona registered office, local statutory agent and corporate secretarial support package
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500–9,500 per annum for a mid-market real-estate portfolio SL with clean books; multi-SPV holdings with numerous leases typically require USD 12,000–25,000
